label: known-capital

message.content:
The capital city of Japan is Tokyo.

Tokyo is a sprawling metropolis that serves as the political, economic, and cultural center of the country. It is known for its unique blend of ultra-modern skyscrapers and traditional temples, bustling neon-lit districts like Shibuya and Shinjuku, and its status as one of the most populous metropolitan areas in the world.
